children: will be reporting earnings tomorrow before market open. Here’s what to expect.

AbbVie beat analysts’ revenue expectations last quarter, reporting revenues of $16.99 billion, up 10.2% year on year. It was a mixed quarter for the company, with a narrow beat of analysts’ EPS estimates but a slight miss of analysts’ full-year EPS guidance estimates.
Is AbbVie a buy or sell going into earnings?

children: This quarter, the market is expecting AbbVie’s revenue to grow 9.9% year on year, in line with the 9.1% increase it recorded in the same quarter last year.

Analysts covering the company have generally reconfirmed their estimates over the last 30 days, suggesting they anticipate the business will stay the course heading into earnings. AbbVie has a history of exceeding Wall Street’s expectations.

Looking at AbbVie’s peers in the biotechnology segment, only Biogen has reported results so far. It exceeded analysts’ revenue estimates, delivering year-on-year sales growth of 10.6%. Read our full analysis of

There has been positive sentiment among investors in the biotechnology segment, with share prices up 6.1% on average over the last month. AbbVie is up 10.6% during the same time and is heading into earnings with an average analyst price target of $283.19 (compared to the current share price of $289.23).
